name: complete-training-readout-gap-v1
data: all unchanged original training records including duplicates, masks and short tails; no validation/test labels enter coefficients or probes
coefficients: all classes, components and both complex coordinates; unconjugated state times actual analytic full-class CE residual and native weight (already includes B), divided by all supervised records
mode_scope: analytic read-only diagnostic of both previously trained modes; not a forward-only training update
probes: fixed feasible readout interpolations evaluated with actual Model.logits; no accepted update, checkpoint or held-out scoring
claim: floating-point diagnostic of exact-real CM103; no certified rounding bound, conditional optimum, factor optimum or unseen identification is assumed
